subtopics.label: IVF and Assisted Reproductive Technology Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on clinical outcomes of in vitro fertilization and assisted reproductive technologies, including embryo transfer protocols, ovarian stimulation, blastocyst quality, ploidy assessment, sperm parameters, and factors affecting live birth rates.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical outcomes of in vitro fertilization, embryo transfer protocols, ovarian stimulation, and factors affecting live birth rates.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Treatment and Clinical Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on systemic therapies, surgical interventions, and clinical outcomes in breast cancer, including chemotherapy regimens, endocrine therapy, targeted agents, immunotherapy, and quality of life during and after treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Systemic therapies, surgical interventions, and quality of life in breast cancer treatment and post-treatment care.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Risk Assessment and Screening
subtopics.description: Research on mammographic screening modalities, breast density, polygenic risk scores, biomarkers, and risk factors for breast cancer detection and prevention, including disparities in screening access and uptake.
subtopics.short_description: Mammographic screening, breast density, polygenic risk scores, and disparities in breast cancer detection and prevention.

subtopics.label: Breast Reconstruction and Surgical Techniques
subtopics.description: Research on postmastectomy breast reconstruction methods including implant-based and autologous approaches, complications such as capsular contracture, sensory outcomes, and disparities in reconstruction access.
subtopics.short_description: Implant-based and autologous breast reconstruction methods, complications, sensory outcomes, and access disparities.

subtopics.label: Gynecologic Oncology: Ovarian, Endometrial, and Cervical Cancers
subtopics.description: Research on the diagnosis, molecular characterization, treatment, and outcomes of gynecologic cancers including ovarian, endometrial, and cervical cancers, as well as genetic risk assessment and fertility-sparing approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, molecular characterization, treatment, and genetic risk assessment of gynecologic cancers.

subtopics.label: Perinatal Mental Health and Reproductive Psychiatry
subtopics.description: Research on anxiety, depression, and psychiatric conditions during pregnancy and the postpartum period, including screening tools, neurobiological mechanisms, treatment approaches, and psychosocial interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Anxiety, depression, and psychiatric conditions during pregnancy and postpartum, including screening and treatment approaches.

subtopics.label: Obstetric Complications, Labor Management, and Maternal Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on obstetric complications including hypertensive disorders, placenta accreta spectrum, labor induction and augmentation, cesarean delivery, and maternal morbidity and mortality, with emphasis on racial and socioeconomic disparities.
subtopics.short_description: Hypertensive disorders, placenta accreta, labor management, cesarean delivery, and maternal morbidity with attention to racial disparities.

subtopics.label: Male Infertility, Sperm Biology, and Contraception
subtopics.description: Research on male infertility evaluation and treatment including sperm function, genetic causes of azoospermia, sperm capacitation biology, and development of non-hormonal male contraceptives targeting soluble adenylyl cyclase.
subtopics.short_description: Sperm function, genetic causes of azoospermia, and development of non-hormonal male contraceptives.

subtopics.label: Reproductive Endocrinology, Ovarian Biology, and Folliculogenesis
subtopics.description: Research on ovarian physiology including follicle development, theca cell biology, anti-Müllerian hormone, ovarian xenograft models, and hormonal regulation of reproductive function including progesterone receptor signaling and meiosis.
subtopics.short_description: Follicle development, anti-Müllerian hormone, theca cell biology, and hormonal regulation of reproductive function.

subtopics.label: Uterine Fibroids, Endometriosis, and Pelvic Floor Disorders
subtopics.description: Research on benign uterine and pelvic conditions including fibroids, endometriosis, pelvic organ prolapse, stress urinary incontinence, and pelvic floor dysfunction, encompassing surgical management and patient-reported outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Benign uterine and pelvic conditions including fibroids, endometriosis, prolapse, and stress urinary incontinence.

subtopics.label: Cervical Cancer Screening, HPV, and Gynecologic Cytology
subtopics.description: Research on cervical cancer prevention including HPV testing, Papanicolaou test practices, colposcopy, high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions, and HPV vaccination uptake and efficacy.
subtopics.short_description: HPV testing, Papanicolaou practices, colposcopy, high-grade lesion management, and HPV vaccination uptake.

subtopics.label: Sex Differences in Cardiovascular Disease and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on sex-based disparities in cardiovascular conditions including coronary artery bypass grafting, myocardial infarction, Takotsubo syndrome, aortic disease, and cardiac interventions, examining mechanisms and outcomes differences between women and men.
subtopics.short_description: Sex-based disparities in coronary artery disease, myocardial infarction, aortic disease, and cardiac intervention outcomes.

subtopics.label: Contraception, Abortion, and Reproductive Rights
subtopics.description: Research on contraceptive methods and counseling, abortion services and stigma, reproductive autonomy, and policy and legal dimensions of reproductive healthcare access including family planning in low-resource settings.
subtopics.short_description: Contraceptive methods, abortion services, reproductive autonomy, and policy dimensions of family planning access.

subtopics.label: Menopause, Perimenopause, and Female Hormonal Neurobiology
subtopics.description: Research on perimenopausal and menopausal physiology including estrogen receptor signaling in the brain and cardiovascular system, neuroinflammation, hypothalamic function, and sex hormone effects on neurological and metabolic outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Perimenopausal physiology, estrogen receptor signaling in the brain, and sex hormone effects on neurological and metabolic outcomes.

subtopics.label: Infectious Disease in Pregnancy: Screening, Prevention, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on infectious diseases during pregnancy including hepatitis B and C, tuberculosis, COVID-19, dengue, and sexually transmitted infections, covering screening strategies, maternal-fetal transmission, vaccination, and clinical outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Screening, prevention, and outcomes for hepatitis, tuberculosis, COVID-19, and STIs during pregnancy.

subtopics.label: Herpes Simplex Virus and STI Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies on herpes simplex virus types 1 and 2 and other sexually transmitted infections including gonorrhea and chlamydia, covering global prevalence, incidence trends, vaccination modeling, and regional burden.
subtopics.short_description: Global prevalence, incidence trends, and regional burden of herpes simplex virus and other sexually transmitted infections.

subtopics.label: Maternal Cytomegalovirus and Congenital Infection
subtopics.description: Studies on maternal cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection, immune responses, antibody correlates of protection, and risk of congenital transmission, including vaccine development and animal models.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal cytomegalovirus immune responses, congenital transmission risk, and vaccine development strategies.

subtopics.label: Penicillin Allergy Management in Pregnancy
subtopics.description: Research on the prevalence, management, and clinical consequences of reported penicillin allergy in pregnant women, including antibiotic prophylaxis for Group B Streptococcus, maternal and neonatal outcomes, and allergy evaluation programs.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence and clinical consequences of reported penicillin allergy in pregnant women, including GBS prophylaxis and allergy evaluation.

subtopics.label: Gestational Diabetes: Epidemiology, Screening, and Management
subtopics.description: Studies on gestational diabetes mellitus including prevalence in diverse populations, screening methods, community health worker interventions, online support, glucose monitoring, and associations with adverse pregnancy outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, screening methods, glucose monitoring, and community interventions for gestational diabetes mellitus.

subtopics.label: Sex Differences in Neurobiology, Brain Function, and Behavior
subtopics.description: Research examining sex-based differences in brain structure, function, gene expression, mitochondrial activity, and behavioral outcomes including depression, stress responses, and resting-state connectivity.
subtopics.short_description: Sex-based differences in brain structure, gene expression, mitochondrial activity, and behavioral outcomes including depression and stress.

subtopics.label: Sex Differences in Surgical and Vascular Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining sex-based disparities in outcomes following vascular and surgical procedures including aortic aneurysm repair, endovascular interventions, lower extremity bypass, hip arthroplasty, and cardiac surgery.
subtopics.display_name: Sex Differences in Surgical & Vascular Outcomes
subtopics.short_description: Sex-based disparities in outcomes after vascular repair, endovascular interventions, arthroplasty, and cardiac surgery.

subtopics.label: Autoimmune and Chronic Disease Management in Pregnancy
subtopics.description: Research on managing autoimmune and chronic conditions during pregnancy including lupus, antiphospholipid syndrome, inflammatory bowel disease, celiac disease, and polycystic kidney disease, covering maternal and fetal outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Managing lupus, antiphospholipid syndrome, inflammatory bowel disease, and other chronic conditions during pregnancy.

subtopics.label: Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Biology and Racial Disparities
subtopics.description: Studies on the molecular biology, genetic ancestry-associated gene expression, metabolic heterogeneity, and racial disparities in triple-negative and inflammatory breast cancer, including targeted therapeutic approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular biology, ancestry-associated gene expression, and racial disparities in triple-negative and inflammatory breast cancer.

subtopics.label: Breast Imaging, Radiology Practice, and Patient-Centered Care
subtopics.description: Research on breast imaging modalities, radiology consultation services, patient-reported outcomes, COVID-19 impacts on breast imaging practice, and radiologic-pathologic correlations in breast lesions.
subtopics.short_description: Breast imaging modalities, patient-reported outcomes, radiologic-pathologic correlations, and COVID-19 impacts on imaging practice.

subtopics.label: Substance Use During Pregnancy: Cannabis, Alcohol, and Policy
subtopics.description: Studies on substance use during pregnancy including cannabis use disorder, alcohol and tobacco use, periconceptional substance use, and policy frameworks for drug treatment access in pregnant populations.
subtopics.short_description: Cannabis, alcohol, and tobacco use during pregnancy, periconceptional exposure, and drug treatment access policy.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 in Pregnancy: Outcomes, Vaccination, and Placental Pathology
subtopics.description: Research on SARS-CoV-2 infection and vaccination during pregnancy, including maternal and neonatal outcomes, placental pathology, antibody responses, long COVID, and obstetric intensive care management.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal and neonatal outcomes, placental pathology, antibody responses, and vaccination during SARS-CoV-2 infection in pregnancy.

subtopics.label: Adolescent Reproductive and Gynecologic Health
subtopics.description: Research addressing reproductive health in adolescents including pelvic examinations, privacy laws, reproductive counseling for girls with epilepsy, vulvar conditions, and differences in sex development.
subtopics.short_description: Reproductive health in adolescents including counseling, vulvar conditions, differences in sex development, and privacy considerations.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Survivorship, Comorbidities, and Quality of Life
subtopics.description: Studies on quality of life, psychosocial well-being, weight management, diabetes co-management, endocrine therapy side effects, and survivorship challenges in breast cancer patients and survivors.
subtopics.display_name: Breast Cancer Survivorship & Quality of Life
subtopics.short_description: Psychosocial well-being, endocrine therapy side effects, weight management, and survivorship challenges in breast cancer patients.
